detail.longDescription:
Python+ helps you learn Python through structured courses, interactive lessons, and chapter quizzes. Follow a guided learning path, track your progress, review mistakes, and put what you learn into practice with real Python code on your device.
From your first print("Hello, World!") to working with data science libraries, build your Python skills one step at a time.

Learn Python Step by Step
Follow a structured roadmap from beginner concepts to advanced Python and data science.
• 8 courses: Python Basics, Intermediate, Advanced, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, SciPy, and scikit-learn
• 128 chapters with clear explanations and practical examples
• 1,000+ interactive lessons combining concepts, code examples, and hands-on exercises
• Roadmap and list views to navigate your courses and follow your progress

Test Your Understanding
Reinforce what you learn with a quiz at the end of every chapter.
• 1,000+ quiz questions across all 8 courses
• Multiple question types, including predict the output, fill in the blank, code builder, and matching
• Instant feedback to help you understand your answers
• Mistake tracking and review to revisit concepts that need more practice

Build a Learning Habit
Keep your learning organized and see how far you have come.
• Track your lesson and course progress
• Earn XP as you learn and practice
• Build learning streaks and unlock achievements
• Return to previous lessons and review at your own pace

Practice with Real Python
Go beyond reading explanations. Run lesson examples, change the code, and explore what happens using the built-in Python 3 runtime.
The integrated editor supports syntax highlighting, auto-indent, code folding, code completion, and an extended coding keyboard. Save your scripts and organize your practice projects with the file and project manager.
Apply what you have learned through coding challenges, or experiment with small projects of your own.

Learn Data Science by Doing
Continue beyond Python fundamentals with courses and built-in libraries for numerical computing, data analysis, visualization, and machine learning.
• NumPy: work with arrays and numerical operations
• pandas: explore and analyze structured data
• Matplotlib: turn data into charts and visualizations
• SciPy: practice scientific computing
• scikit-learn: explore machine learning concepts with code

Run examples, experiment with datasets, and connect each lesson to practical Python skills.
As your learning progresses, search for and install additional Python packages from PyPI for use in your projects. An internet connection is required to search for and download packages.

Learn Wherever You Are
Study lessons and run Python code offline. Practice during a commute, between classes, or whenever you have time. Follow the learning path or revisit a topic you want to understand better.

Who Is Python+ For?
Python+ is designed for beginners learning Python from scratch, students reinforcing classroom concepts, self-taught learners looking for a structured path, and anyone ready to explore data science through hands-on practice.

Download Python+ and start learning, practicing, and building your Python skills today.
